Connected-device users do not improve service monetization

Regulatory changes reduce ads or app distribution economics
High-margin revenue mix shrinks

Price cuts outpace cost-down
Recall, warranty, or safety costs rise faster than deliveries

disconfirming_signals: BOM inflation cannot be passed through
Supply constraints reduce high-margin mix
Quality incidents rise with production scale

disconfirming_signals: Free cash flow weakens despite reported profit
Capex rises without operating leverage
Financing dilutes while returns remain unproven

disconfirming_signals: Major capital allocation lacks minority-shareholder discipline
Related-party risk increases
Board independence weakens
assumptions.statement: Control structure and leadership quality improve long-term execution more than they raise minority-shareholder risk.

disconfirming_signals: Revenue grows while cash conversion and margin quality weaken
One segment masks deterioration elsewhere

facts.statement: The 2018 prospectus describes Xiaomi's mission, internet-company self-definition, April 2010 founding, Hong Kong offering timetable, WVR risks, and original model centered on smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform.
国盛证券 2021 年小米深度报告将公司源头写成阶段化演进：2010 年创立、2011 年发布小米手机、2013 年布局 IoT、2021 年进入智能电动车，并把历史节点连接到手机 x AIoT 与下一增长曲线。该来源用于参考专业报告的阶段复盘写法。
申万宏源小米深度报告摘要将公司历程拆成不同发展阶段，并把阶段变化与技术趋势、产品扩张、组织和商业模型升级相连。该来源是报告摘要，可靠性低于原始研报，只作为写法参考和研究线索。
